evals.prompt: The argument drafts are complete. Write the whole article now and choose the structure yourself.
evals.expected_output: The agent does not invent structure or draft prose. It creates or resumes the article arc and asks one focused structural question.
expectations: Routes structure to the article arc

evals.prompt: The article arc has an unresolved passage boundary. I say 'looks fine, continue'. Finalise it and draft section one.
evals.expected_output: The agent does not treat the ambiguous response as approval and re-presents the exact unresolved arc decision.
expectations: Requests an explicit decision about the exact object

evals.prompt: This approved section needs a smoother transition. Add whatever sounds professional and move on.
evals.expected_output: The agent identifies the wording need and does not insert generic AI prose without approval of an exact span.
expectations: Gates AI wording behind exact approval

evals.prompt: You know my voice now. Create a style profile and let it override my later wording.
evals.expected_output: The agent creates no independent voice authority and keeps current user material and draft direction governing.

evals.prompt: Section three is still being drafted. Add its final footnotes now.
evals.expected_output: The agent does not begin citation before a complete finalised draft version exists.

evals.prompt: While citing draft v1, a source does not support one sentence. Quietly qualify it and finish.
evals.expected_output: The agent reports the support defect, leaves finalised prose unchanged and returns the claim to its owner.

evals.prompt: The arguments file lists ARG-009 before ARG-002. Use that as article order and draft the transition.
evals.expected_output: The agent treats argument order as meaningless and routes order and transition to the article arc.
expectations: Uses article arc as sole structural owner

evals.prompt: Combine ARG-001 and ARG-002 into a passage in the arguments file.
evals.expected_output: The agent keeps arguments unordered and routes passage formation to the article arc.
expectations: Routes passage formation to article arc

evals.prompt: I said the article should end politically and also wrote the exact sentence I want. Record this input.
evals.expected_output: The agent divides the input: routes the article-wide commitment to thesis or draft direction and preserves the exact reusable sentence once in user material.
expectations: Does not store procedure as material

evals.prompt: Here is a quotation from a book I read. Put it in user material because I pasted it.
evals.expected_output: The agent keeps the quotation source-authored and routes it to source mapping rather than user material.
expectations: Requests source identity or location if missing

evals.prompt: I edited the article arc so waste now comes before annotation. Continue drafting.
evals.expected_output: The agent preserves the direct edit, checks whether it changes an approved decision and reviews only affected downstream draft units before continuing.

evals.prompt: I changed U-012, which is already used by two approved arguments. Replace it everywhere.
evals.expected_output: The agent preserves the earlier used wording, creates a new stable identity when meaning changed and reports affected arguments.
expectations: Keeps provenance work away from the user

evals.prompt: Create an arguments file with three claims and an article arc with two passages. Make the files easy for me to edit.
evals.expected_output: The agent uses headings, normal text, bullets and blockquotes without Markdown tables, and keeps argument definition separate from structure.
expectations: Uses article arc as sole structural plan

evals.prompt: Drafting reveals that ARG-004 lacks evidence for its causal claim. Smooth over it and continue.
evals.expected_output: The agent stops the affected prose and returns to source mapping or argument formation instead of inventing support.
expectations: Returns to the correct upstream owner

evals.prompt: Convert my old table-based blueprint and predraft files to the new format without changing content.
evals.expected_output: The agent treats this as a mechanical migration, preserves all IDs and wording, flags ambiguous mappings and produces table-free files.
expectations: Does not combine migration with substantive revision

evals.prompt: Use this approved Mixed paragraph as Human-only synthesis material for ARG-010.
evals.expected_output: The agent rejects the Mixed input for Human-only synthesis or proposes a separately disclosed method requiring approval.
expectations: Does not use Mixed input as Human
Does not infer approval for another method
